QuestInfo.name: [Fantasy Theme World] Party Prep
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Nurse Aily about how #bDelilah#k is doing.
QuestInfo.1: Help with the event prep by gathering #b50 balloons#k. You'll need to defeat #rClowning Scarlion#k in #bExtreme Station <1>#k, then find Nurse Aily in #bFunky Station <3>#k.
QuestInfo.2: You took care of everything just as Nurse Aily told you.

0.msg: Delilah just fainted! Fortunately, it doesn't seem to be anything serious, but why in the world would you enter a place that clearly says it's a #eRestricted Area#n?!

1.msg: #b(You coax Dylan into telling Nurse Aily what's been going on.)#k

2.msg: You mean to tell me that strange red-caped person suggested it? Oh my. Targa and Scarboss are no laughing matter. You must have great skill to have defeated them, #e#h0##n. And I can't believe there's something so silly as a cardiotachometer confession... \nAnyway, didn't you say you wanted to prepare an event?

3.msg: It's not really an event exactly. After all the trouble I caused Delilah today, I think it's time I apologize and be honest with her about my true feelings.

4.msg: That's what I mean! You should make it an event! I can help!

0.msg: Every event needs balloons! Please get a bunch of this specific #i	4033238# #b#t4033238##k from #rClowning Scarlion#k in #bExtreme Station <1>#k. And we should hold the event in Delilah's favorite place. You know... #e'the place'#n? She'll love it! I'll meet you there.

no.0: It's always good to get help from others when you need it.

1.0: Did you get all the #bballoons#k we need?

yes.0: This is coming along nicely! We have plenty of #bballoons#k and the man of the hour. All we need now is the lovely lady!
